name: Ergasterion lessons
say: This week we wrote down 6 lessons. The strongest (2 files agree): No management change (partials, stair stops, stale exits, news exits, a later cut) and no entry-window or per-session change holds in both halves. What changed our mind: One pocket looked real (and replicated across two assets) until I ran it on two months of data it had never seen: it vanished.

week.text: No management change (partials, stair stops, stale exits, news exits, a later cut) and no entry-window or per-session change holds in both halves.
None gives an edge that survives fees, a held-out block and a second asset.

No edge found. Out of the 38 cells that were big enough to test (and 7 pre-written textbook ideas), none beat the noise on training data, and none is positive with a confidence interval above zero on the held-out last 14 days.

BLITZ - one sizing change holds - on the 25K eval, the day's FIRST band break on a side trades half size and a LATER same-side break 1.75 x today's size (never more than the room).

The best makes about +$270 to +$360 a month in each 2026 half at $100 risk a trade, but the same idea on 5m bars loses about $320 a month over 2021-25 and its eval pass rate is no better than a coin flip.

changed.text: One pocket looked real (and replicated across two assets) until I ran it on two months of data it had never seen: it vanished.

The earlier finding "95c and above is +1.4% per $" came from the bot's own bets (no market-wide data). On the market-wide data it is +0.1% (train) and -0.6% (test): that pocket is not an edge, it is the bot's entry timing plus luck.
The H2 gain of the pick (fail in 2 weeks 17.4% vs 21.7%) rests on 31 trades and does not hold in 2021-25.
If shuffled outcomes do as well, the previous result carries no information.
A lead that did not hold: the other way round, years of memory and a later period as the check:

note: Every lesson is a sentence lifted from a file in the repo; strength = how many independent files agree. Research notes, never a trade signal.
